svg.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Close-up: how the screen sits behind the window
Two enlarged pieces of the cross-section, serving side on the left. Scale 20 px = 1 mm. Sizes in mm (inches in brackets).
The chamfer runs through the whole 2.4 mm wall at 45°, so
no square inner edge is left: the full chamfer keeps the
picture clear from above. No lid lip on this side: the
strip of foam tape sits there instead. The rim runs all
round the glass and is broken only at the ribbon cut-out.
Tape, and the ribbon where it may bend
Picture area edge, and the ribbon where it stays straight
(b) Bottom edge of the window, at the ribbon
Bend zone (orange): only this 5.5 mm (0.22 in) of ribbon may bend.
The relaxed U, about 1.5 mm (0.06 in) radius, fits wholly inside it.
and let tape hold the glass
The wall is only a frame in front of
the glass and never touches it. Tape
holds it; the rim only locates it.
No clips, screws or tight rims: the
rim only locates it. Bare glass
or bend it past the zone
One relaxed U, nothing sharper, and
only in the 5.5 mm next to the
glass. Past that it stays straight.
The U sits right at the sled's bottom
edge. On the bench lay the sled face
up, or sit it in a printed stand.
